title: Shadow Gear Guide
summary: The basics of Shadow Gear, its slots and set effects.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: ※ Shadow Gear is added step by step with server updates.
※ Some gear is not available yet or will be added later through Lucky Eggs.
Shadow Gear is special equipment worn separately from regular equipment. It gives a variety of effects such as higher stats, skill bonuses, defense piercing and reduced casting time.
Shadow Gear can be worn alongside regular equipment, and set effects give extra stats. Some Shadow Gear also has effects specialized for particular jobs.
